description: An envelope generator with a shape control, end-of-stage triggers, an inverted output and a built-in stereo amplifier

params.text: Opens the envelope by hand, working as the G/T jack does in whichever mode the module is in
Chooses how the envelope runs: ENV holds at sustain while the gate is high, FN runs attack then decay from a trigger, LP repeats attack and decay until a second trigger sends it to release
Bends the envelope curve between exponential, gentle, linear and logarithmic, with the mid positions falling between them
Sets how long the rise takes, 1ms to 10 seconds
Sets how long the fall from full to the sustain level takes, 1ms to 10 seconds
Sets the level the envelope holds at, 0% to 100%
Sets how long the fall to silence takes, 1ms to 10 seconds
Sets how far the INV output drops when the envelope rises, 0% to 100%; at 0% that output stays at 10V
Sets the level of the built-in amplifier, 0% to 100%

inputs.text: Opens the envelope: held high in ENV mode, or a trigger in FN and LP modes; its channel count sets the polyphony of the envelope outputs
A trigger here restarts the attack from wherever the envelope has reached, during decay or sustain
Bends the envelope curve, a tenth of its voltage scaled by the trimpot beside it and added to the shape knob
Lengthens the attack, one second per volt at full attenuverter, added to the ATT knob and floored at 1ms
Lengthens the decay, one second per volt at full attenuverter, added to the DEC knob and floored at 1ms
Shifts the sustain level, a tenth of its voltage scaled by the trimpot above it and added to the SUS knob
Lengthens the release, one second per volt at full attenuverter, added to the REL knob and floored at 1ms
The left signal for the built-in amplifier
The right signal for the built-in amplifier
Sets the amplifier level: with a monophonic envelope it multiplies the LVL knob, 10V giving the knob's own setting, and with a polyphonic envelope a tenth of its voltage is added to the knob instead

outputs.text: A 1ms pulse when the attack stage ends
A 1ms pulse when the decay stage ends
A 1ms pulse when the sustain stage ends
A 1ms pulse when the release stage ends
The envelope turned upside down: 10V at rest, falling as the envelope rises, by as much as the INV knob allows
The left signal at the envelope's level, scaled by the amplifier level and clamped to ±10V
The right signal at the envelope's level, scaled by the amplifier level and clamped to ±10V

notes: with the LVL knob at zero and a voltage at the LVL jack, the amplifier is silent, because on a monophonic envelope the jack multiplies the knob rather than adding to it.
